timeline.text: There are two different times for game day — when to actually show up, and when the whistle blows.
Our kiosk only ever showed the whistle time, copied straight from Spond's kickoff field.
A kid told to arrive early walked in exactly on time — and still looked late.
Now the kiosk compares both times and shows both when they're far enough apart.
A five-minute gap stays simple, but a real one prints clearly — 17:15 to 18:00.
